title: Use-after-free in PyObject_CallFinalizer when __del__ changes __class__
author: yet-another-agent
body_preview: ### Bug description  `PyObject_CallFinalizer()` keeps a borrowed pointer to the object's original type across `tp_finalize(self)`. A Python `__del__` method can change `self.__class__`; cyclic GC can then free the original heap type before `PyObject_CallFinalizer()` reads `tp->tp_flags` again, causing a heap use-after-free.
